name: settled-entrances
title: Settled Entrances
description: A scope inside which Reveal, Stagger, Counter and PresenceItem render already settled (no entrance); hover and other motion are untouched.

name: reveal
title: Reveal
description: Enter on mount or in view with fade, rise, blur-in, scale or clip-wipe (4 directions); exits via AnimatePresence; delay as a stagger-token multiple.

name: stagger
title: Stagger
description: Orchestrates children in sequence with a stagger token, ordered from start, end, center or seeded random; plays in view.

name: magnetic
title: Magnetic
description: Pulls an element toward the pointer within a radius with a spring return; MagneticInner adds label parallax.

name: tilt
title: Tilt
description: 3D pointer tilt with perspective, optional compositor-only glare and a spring reset.

name: text-split
title: TextSplit
description: Splits text by chars, words or measured lines (resize and font safe) and reveals with any Reveal variant; accessible text preserved.

name: scramble-text
title: ScrambleText
description: Decode/scramble toward target text with a configurable glyph set; triggers on mount, view, hover/focus or text change.

name: counter
title: Counter
description: Animated number with Intl.NumberFormat and tabular numerals; tween or odometer roll; retargets mid-animation.

name: text-effect
title: TextEffect
description: Text renderer with a chosen reveal: split-flap board, terminal typing, decode, word blur-in or rolling reels; reserves the final box, one accessible copy, replays on text change.

name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: Seamless infinite loop, horizontal or vertical; auto-fills, faded edges, eases to a stop on hover/focus, pauses offscreen.

name: scroll-progress
title: ScrollProgress
description: Spring-smoothed bar or ring bound to page or container scroll, exposed as a progressbar.

name: parallax
title: Parallax
description: Scroll-linked translate, scale, rotate and opacity mapped from an input range to output ranges.
